## Result

- Skill: proposal-review
- Review status: approved
- Vision alignment: aligned
- Material findings: none from this bounded Proposal assessment.
- Open blockers: no proposal-level decision remains; reported CI failure and downstream review obligations are not waived.
- Proposal readiness: unchanged approved direction remains applicable with the user-authorized bounded stale-script disposition.
- Immediate next stage: isolated stop; independent Design Review owns the exact amendment.
- Automatic downstream handoff: none.
- Claim limitations: direction reliance only. No script/test deletion, Design/implementation approval, CI success, fresh Verify or PR readiness is established.

## Bounded amendment assessment

Only Release changed among r6's recorded current-owner subjects; the proposal and other governing/current context are unchanged. The user expressly requested stale Release-script removal in the existing change. Release now selects the unused validate-release-ci.py compatibility alias for retirement while naming validate-release.py --recorded-source-auto as its canonical replacement, preserving recorded-commit validation and retaining meaningful standalone preparation/preflight/public-closeout entrypoints with their separate uses.

This is bounded Release consumer/entrypoint reconciliation consistent with the approved initiative and latest user instruction. It neither removes canonical validation nor extends retirement to arbitrary scripts, historical evidence or unrelated operations. The entrypoint removal is explicit rather than disguised as behavior-preserving prose cleanup. The precise consumer audit, compatibility disposition, wrapper-specific test removal and retained protection require Design/Delivery and implementation review; this judgment does not approve them automatically.

Read-only baseline inspection found validate-release-ci.py delegates to validate-release.py with --recorded-source-auto and preserves its return code; validation_selection.py invokes the canonical option directly and separately recognizes the wrapper path for impact selection. These observations support direction feasibility only. They are not a whole-repository no-reader finding or proof of safe completed deletion. Historical path recognition is not by itself a need to retain an executable alias. The complete routine path still performs required work automatically, while retained exceptional/helper entrypoints do not become normal maintainer tasks.

The reported detached-clone fixture failure remains an implementation/evidence concern owned by its correction and review stages. No change to intended product behavior is selected to turn that failure green; this Proposal judgment neither labels it passed nor restores affected implementation/Verify evidence.

## Review Dimensions

- Challenge: pass. Fragmented/duplicated Release responsibility and unnecessary routine coordination remain concrete.
- Goals: pass. One normal approval, automated required work/evidence, coherent Release ownership and justified source cleanup remain unchanged.
- Scope: pass. Latest user-authorized alias retirement is explicit and bounded; canonical protective checks, meaningful standalone operations and separately owned work remain preserved.
- Governing principle: pass. Execute and verify the exact authorized operation and retain necessary meaning rather than duplicate representations.
- Direction: pass. Exact candidate authority, public facts, safe retry and truthful nonblocking duration telemetry remain unchanged.
- Feasibility: pass. Existing canonical command/delegation and current selector supply a concrete basis for Design's bounded disposition; implementation adequacy remains unclaimed.
- Material impact: pass. The amendment explicitly ends support for one filename and retains its canonical behavior. It does not silently waive recorded-source validation or turn a known failed check into success.
- Vision alignment: pass, aligned. Current readable ownership, retained protection and explicit outcomes preserve trustworthy traceable work.
- Downstream authority: pass. Exact deletion, consumers, tests and evidence remain with their normal author/reviewer stages.
- Requested decision: pass. No new product direction or broad validation redesign is required for the explicit user-requested bounded cleanup.

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass. No prior user goal disappears. Keeping useful standalone methods is consistent with retiring stale machinery rather than deleting all thin entrypoints indiscriminately.
- Current reliance continues to use the unchanged proposal, Constitution/Vision, Release, System, Design, mixed-source ownership amendment and follow-up ownership. As explicitly established in r6, none of the six removed original specifications/test specifications/ADRs is required for this current direction judgment. Historical proposal/source citations and r1–r6 judgments retain their original meaning; no old approval is retargeted.
- R6 stays original/stale because its Release contextual identity changed. This new judgment uses current owner identities and does not restore r6 by replacing its subject hash.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required for this bounded user-selected disposition.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: approve continued direction reliance and return the exact amendment to independent Design Review. Preserve the known CI failure and required correction/reassessment until actual supporting evidence is available.
- Checks actually run: bounded Release diff and current-subject comparison; read-only wrapper and canonical selector inspection; primary CLI context and full subject inspect; targeted batch recording. No script was deleted, no runtime/release operation was executed, and no CI pass was inferred. Scoped structural record validation and git diff hygiene follow recording.

## Specialized-gate group

- Active gate predicates: scope_budget_context=true; vision_exception_context=false; standing_artifact_context=false.
- Gate outcomes: scope-budget pass; exact alias retirement is bounded and other operational responsibilities remain explicit.
- Trigger ambiguity: none.

## Durable-recording group

- Recording status: recorded through targeted batch on successful save.
- Recording blocker: none.
- Record path: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r7.json
- Finding-record paths: none new from Proposal Review; other stage findings retain their own disposition authority.

## Formal-review group

- Review ID: proposal-review-r7
- Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r7.json
- Governed change identity: 2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation
- Invocation classification: formal-lifecycle/manual; PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
- Independence: original independent Proposal assessor authored none of the reviewed proposal, Design amendment or implementation. Only this judgment/applicability is written; engineering, findings and activity/work routing remain unchanged.
independence_basis: Original independent Proposal assessor authored no proposal, engineering amendment or implementation; independently judged bounded current direction/reliance under explicit user-requested stale-script cleanup.
